rv.q: With visual vibrance and refreshing honesty, Heartbreak Hotel pumps fresh blood into the breakup narrative.
The production style is holding back the genuinely interesting content of the show.
If the journey proves more taxing than transformative, it nonetheless leaves a distinct impression.
Ultimately, though, it is a brave attempt to examine seemingly every nook and cranny of love that goes wrong

cn.t: New Zealand duo EBKM delivers a quirky, inventive exploration of post-breakup grief that blends performance art with synth-driven music and familiar breakup songs, earning modest praise for its creative approach despite the creators' self-professed lack of formal training.
